body:
REMOTE-PIN BASELINE VERIFIED before any bump.

From StoryAtlas main `d295f4cd67a472d5a0cc295e1c163f5e97805e2b`, I ran exactly:

`sbt -Dsbt.supershell=false compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS`

No `storyatlas4s.storymodel4s.build`, `storymodel4s.grakern.build`, or Intaglio checkout override was present. sbt loaded its staged remote source builds and completed with exit 0. The resolved checkouts were:

- storymodel4s `3cf704a743d251b0ca09a3238b059e41883370af`, remote `bbuchsbaum/storymodel4s`;
- grakern `0329c43c88a0b71e9aa4456723bb16bac2fa3841`, remote `canardlapin/grakern`.

Observed tests: layout JVM 22, layout JS 26, Intaglio JVM 14, Intaglio JS 14, CLI 15, app JS 17: 108 total, zero failures/errors. `compileAll`, `scalafmtCheckAll`, and `app/fastLinkJS` also completed successfully. `git diff --quiet`, `git diff --cached --quiet`, and tracked-only status were clean afterwards.

This proves the current declared dependency chain is remotely reproducible and that the StoryAtlas instructions saying the grakern override is mandatory are stale. It does not prove compatibility with a future storymodel4s target; that target still needs the old/new artifact-parity and browser courts in the parent post.
